children: Vroom’s revenue increased slightly year over year as lower noninterest income was more than offset by higher net interest income. The net loss narrowed, primarily as realized and unrealized losses fell, reflecting lower loss assumptions on receivables originated since September 2025 and improved performance in vintages using its redeveloped credit-scoring model; higher expenses partly offset the improvement.
² Reported as “Net loss attributable to controlling interest and common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Total net loss per share attributable to common stockholders, basic and diluted”.
: Realized and unrealized losses fell 52.8% to $20.4M, primarily reflecting lower loss assumptions on receivables originated since September 2025.
: Interest income declined 2.6% to $43.7M, primarily as the loan portfolio balance decreased to $803.0M from $817.7M.
: Revenue was $1.3M, down 6.4% year over year; adjusted net loss was $0.1M, compared with $0.1M in the prior-year quarter.
: Facility Two expired on September 30, 2026, and was not renewed; Facility One was renewed through June 2027.
